items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I heard him at the Paramount... Benny coming in -- Benny Goodman. He followed Artie in there. I was comparing the two of them.

ctx.x: But he was quite a technician.

Oh, he was a great clarinetist. But I didn't know... I wasn't interested in clarinet. I never learned clarinet. I didn't like clarinet until I heard Artie Shaw play it. No, I heard Buster Bailey. I liked him. I liked Buster. But the rest of the clarinet players I didn't like, until I heard Artie Shaw; and Artie Shaw woke me up. And it looked like the next week... Let me see, I heard him at the Paramount, and it looked like the following week or two or whatever, Artie's date.... Then Benny coming in -- Benny…
And then when Artie passed out the picture, when I heard him speak on the air one night about, well, you know, it's not so great being number two...
